workload: All sessions and one incident per two sessions. Cold eval/status replies/DOM/layout; complete unchanged and two-row changed refreshes. No caps/culling/pagination.
memoryScope: CDP JSHeapUsedSize after explicit collection, total for this page; not process RSS.
performanceClaim: No blanket speedup or zero-cost feature claim. The complete 1,000-session cold median rose from 138.8 ms to 194.8 ms; that added-control/source-logic cost and broad cold-run variation remain disclosed. At 2,000 sessions cold medians were 331.2/335.3 ms, unchanged refresh 19.3/18.0 ms and two-row changed refresh 27.7/22.6 ms. The candidate adds selectable incident controls, bounded action handling, profile drafts and delivery evidence. Caching/reconciliation reduce repeated equivalent model/DOM work, but these mixed measurements are not promoted as a verified zero-loss optimization win.
measurementBoundaries: Real isolated Chromium headless shell 158.0.8127.0 on the same Linux host, with alternated variant order and 11 fresh pages per variant/size. No prewarming, culling, content-visibility suppression, pagination, reduced rows or deferred mandatory work.

Cold means evaluation, cloned complete status replies, all DOM creation and forced whole-document layout in a new page within an already running isolated browser; it is not process startup, disk-cache cold start or owner-machine responsiveness.
All sessions and all matching incidents are present after every sample. The 1000/2000-row UI stress fixtures intentionally exceed native transport capacity without changing that capacity.
A changed sample changes one session title and one incident reason; all other visible records remain. Heap is CDP JavaScript heap after explicit GC, not process RSS, OS memory or GPU use.
The v0.24 baseline lacks the new controls/behavior; both receive the same complete data. Functional/correctness work and its costs are explicit, not represented as equivalent feature guarantees.
p95/p99 use nearest-rank order statistics; at 11 samples both select the maximum. Full sample distributions and observed variation remain in this receipt.

Input source hashes are checked against the final candidate. Local fixtures are not installed-MV3, physical sound, operating-system notification or authenticated-provider acceptance. Hosted runtime gates remain separate.

engineeringReview.profiling: logs/release-0.25.0/ui-profile.json; actual production function wrapping and DOM mutation observation identified model/reconciliation work. Complete model reuse and stable-order row replacement avoid repeated allocation and preserve original controls. No row or feature removal was tested or retained.
engineeringReview.semanticProof: tests/agent-monitor-ui-logic.test.mjs and tests/smoke/agent_monitor_smoke.py cover full inventory, final-row changes, search, selection scopes, failures, malformed replies, stop/deadlines, profile races, delivery ambiguity and focus.
